name: Wasa Video
excerpt: Wasa Video is a case study of the warship Wasa, illustrating project management failures.
notes: The Wasa Video is a case study that discusses the warship Wasa, which underwent numerous changes such as speeding up the ship, increasing its size, and adding double cannons, leading to its sinking after 15 minutes. It highlights the consequences of unmanaged scope changes.
context_summary:
- Case study of the warship Wasa.

- Added double cannons.
